text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Wednesday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- A new national conservative party was formed on Saturday by the country's leading conservative parties, the Fatherland and Freedom Party and the LNNK. The new party, called Fatrherland and Freedom/LNNK, elected former Fatherland and Freedom chairman Martins Grinbalts as its chairman.
- Foreign minister Valdis Birkavs called on NATO to admit the Baltic states during its second wave of expansion at an alliance seminar in Prauge.
- The director of the European multilateral commission, Anhel Vinas, said that if Latvia wants to join the EU it has to solve all problems regarding non-citizens.
